snippet.title: Astro Loopers - Official Trailer [English Ver.]
snippet.description:
🚀 The latest trailer for Astro Loopers!

What if you could rewind time — and team up with your past self?
Astro Loopers is a Sokoban-style puzzle game set in a cosmic universe, where every move echoes through time. 
Your past characters repeat their actions as time loops stack up — coordinate them to solve increasingly mind-bending stages.

Try the DEMO and wishlist the game on Steam!
